chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: Early repertoire and arranger Pin Madera
summary: The first book included El Muerto se fue de Rumba and Chacumbele; Pin Madera was the first arranger.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose

blocks.x: Okay. Ahhh, do you remember the music of that original band?
Well, we had "El Muerto se fue de Rumba", we had "Chacumbele", we had many, many, many ......
"Sopa de Pichon" came later, right? after.....
later
Okay, so you had "El Muerto se fue de Rumba", what about "Nague"?
"Nague" wasn't there, no.....
Wasn't there yet.
.....no, no because the original, in that particular vein, that we were rehearsing, was Pin Madera, he was the first one to arrange for the band. Then one day Mario called ......
Where did Pin Madera come from? Was he a jazzman also or did he come from another latin band?
Well, he played with Noble Sissle. He played with American and Latin band.
He played with American and Latin bands.
Yes, tremendous musician.
And he was also an arranger.
Right
A very good arranger.
Very good one.
Yeah, okay, and you had "El Muerto se fue de Rumba" ......
"El Muerto se fue de Rumba" and and we ah,
Ah!! we had so many numbers; listen, you know, that's forty years ago.
Yeah. "Chacumbele"......
"Chacumbele", ahh, "Deja Mundo Como Esta" and so forth, so on. We made a lot of numbers.
